name: ProcessCircle
description: Circular progress indicator widget for displaying percentage or value progress in IBM Business Automation Workflow with Carbon Design System styling

configOptions.name: MinValue
configOptions.label: Minimum Value
configOptions.description: Minimum value for the progress range

configOptions.name: MaxValue
configOptions.label: Maximum Value
configOptions.description: Maximum value for the progress range

configOptions.name: postParameter
configOptions.label: Display Suffix
configOptions.description: Text suffix displayed after the value (e.g., '%', 'pts', 'items', 'tasks')

configOptions.name: CircleSize
configOptions.label: Circle Size
configOptions.description: Size of the progress circle (CSS value, e.g., '12rem', '200px')

configOptions.name: RingThickness
configOptions.label: Ring Thickness
configOptions.description: Thickness of the progress ring (CSS value, e.g., '0.5rem', '8px')
